bca_planet_setting_zone_select_toggle_z1_icon = {
    potential = {
        always = yes
    }
    allow = {
        custom_tooltip = {
            fail_text = "BCA_MATCHED_ZONE_SELECTION_NOT_ALLOW"
            OR = {
                NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_disable_planet_auto_destruction_zone }
                NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_z1 }
            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_ext_zone_z1
            }
            remove_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_ext_zone_z1
            bca_planet_setting_clear_zone_selector_flags = yes
        }
        else = {
            clear_open_selector = yes
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_ext_zone_z1
            bca_primary_district_update_zone_options = {
                ZONE_SLOT = z1
            }
        }
    }
}

    }
    allow = {

    }
    effect = {

bca_planet_setting_z1_s1 = {
    potential = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_ext_zone_z1
        check_variable = {
            which = zone_selector_options_count
            value >= 1
        }
    }
    allow = {
        always = yes
    }
    effect = {
        bca_planet_setting_clear_zone_selection = {
            ZONE_SLOT = z1
        }
        bca_planet_setting_set_zone_type_selection = {
            ZONE_SLOT = z1
            SELECTOR_SLOT = s1
        }
        remove_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_ext_zone_z1
        bca_planet_setting_clear_zone_selector_flags = yes
    }
}

        check_variable = {
            which = zone_selector_options_count
            value >= 1
        }
    }
    allow = {
        always = yes
    }
    effect = {
        bca_planet_setting_clear_zone_selection = {
            ZONE_SLOT = z3
        }
        bca_planet_setting_set_zone_type_selection = {
            ZONE_SLOT = z3
            SELECTOR_SLOT = s1
        }
        remove_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_ext_zone_z3
        bca_planet_setting_clear_secondary_zone_selector_flags = yes
    }
}

bca_planet_setting_zone_select_toggle_z4_icon = {
    potential = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_show_detailed_secondary_districts
    }
    allow = {
        custom_tooltip = {
            fail_text = "BCA_MATCHED_ZONE_SELECTION_NOT_ALLOW"
            OR = {
                NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_disable_planet_auto_destruction_zone }
                NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_z4 }
            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_ext_zone_z4
            }
            remove_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_ext_zone_z4
            bca_planet_setting_clear_secondary_zone_selector_flags = yes
        }
        else = {
            clear_open_selector = yes
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_ext_zone_z4
            bca_secondary_district_update_zone_options = {
                ZONE_SLOT = z4
            }
        }
    }
}


bca_planet_setting_z4_icon = {
    potential = {
        has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_show_detailed_secondary_districts
    }
    allow = {
        always = yes
    }
    effect = {
    }
}

bca_planet_setting_zone_select_toggle_zx_icon = {
    potential = {
        bca_has_advance_secondary_districts = yes
        NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_show_detailed_secondary_districts }
    }
    allow = {
        custom_tooltip = {
            fail_text = "BCA_MATCHED_ZONE_SELECTION_NOT_ALLOW"
            OR = {
                NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_disable_planet_auto_destruction_zone }
                NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_zone_selection_matched_zx }
            }
        }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_ext_zone_zx
            }
            remove_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_ext_zone_zx
            bca_planet_setting_clear_secondary_zone_selector_flags = yes
        }
        else = {
            clear_open_selector = yes
            set_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_ext_zone_zx
            bca_secondary_district_update_zone_options = {
                ZONE_SLOT = zx
            }
        }
    }
}


bca_planet_setting_zx_icon = {
    potential = {
        bca_has_advance_secondary_districts = yes
        NOT = { has_carrier_flag = bca_pf_ps_show_detailed_secondary_districts }
    }
    allow = {
        always = yes
    }
    effect = {
    }
}
